# `log2`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
log2(expr)
```

Returns the logarithm of `expr` with base 2.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
